title: Advancing Data Equity: Practitioner Responsibility and Accountability in NLP Data Practices
benchmark_measurement: The paper did not conduct a benchmark measurement related to faith or religion. The study focused on how NLP practitioners perceive and navigate issues of data equity, particularly concerning race, ethnicity, and linguistic diversity.
findings: The paper does not contain any findings related to religion, as it was not a focus of the study. The findings relate to practitioners' perspectives on data equity, organizational constraints, and governance, with a focus on racial and linguistic fairness.
